ns2:course.label: Concurrent Progrmg Languages
ns2:course.description: Theory of concurrency and concurrent programming languages. Formal models of concurrent computation such as process algebras, nets, and actors; high level concurrent programming languages and their operational semantics; methods for reasoning about correctness and complexity of concurrent programs. Prerequisite: CS 422; one of CS 475, MATH 475 or CS 476.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CS 422; one of CS 475, MATH 475 or CS 476.
